name.value: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Kelowna Airport

description.value: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Kelowna Airport is a 140-room mid-scale hotel situated directly adjacent to Kelowna International Airport in the Lake Country/Winfield area. Part of the globally recognized Hampton by Hilton brand, it serves both air travellers and regional visitors exploring the Okanagan. Its location on Innovation Drive puts cyclists within reach of Kelowna's trail networks and wine country routes.
